summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting without running any tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a (ControlType, str) variant in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 title sequence to the formatting table and a Control.title classmethod with a docstring; rich/console.py adds set_window_title (checks only is_terminal, returns True when written, False otherwise) beside set_alt_screen with the requested docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) once per title control; CHANGELOG.md gets an Added section under Unreleased with a bullet linking pull request 2200; tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Not verified: test results, mypy, and Black formatting, since I was instructed not to run anything. Diff is uncommitted in the working tree.
